Wanna get something cool? I have some new clothes in store for you, but it's rare and not cheap. Bring me these things, and make sure they're pristine, no traders. My supplies are completely out and I'm overwhelmed with orders. You can check Ultra, they used to sell those materials there back in the day, but the looters probably took it all over Tarkov. Let me make a list for you, I need a lot of stuff.}} ====USEC Exclusive==== {{quote|Come on in, no need to stand in the doorway. I have a job for you. I'm all busy with orders, and I'm almost out of materials. Can you find me some? I'll be able to offer you something new in return. It won't be cheap though. Made in.. well, you know where. And yeah, make sure that those materials are pristine, get them yourself, without traders' help. Anyway, bring them in as soon as you get them. Find them wherever you want, but I think there was a big supply of them in Ultra mall. Lemme make a list for you.}} ==Requirements== * Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Ragman]] to obtain this quest. ==Objectives== * Find 5 [[Aramid fiber fabric|Aramid fabrics]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Hand over 5 [[Aramid fiber fabric|Aramid fabrics]] to [[Ragman]] * Find 10 [[Ripstop fabric|Ripstop fabrics]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Hand over 10 [[Ripstop fabric|Ripstop fabrics]] to [[Ragman]] * Find 3 [[Paracord|Paracords]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Hand over 3 [[Paracord|Paracords]] to [[Ragman]] ==Rewards== * +32,000 [[EXP]] * 100,000 Roubles ** 105,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 115,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * Unlocks purchase of [[IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam)]] at [[Ragman]] LL4 ====BEAR Exclusive==== * Unlocks purchase of [[BEAR TIGR lower]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL3 {{quote|You got it? Nice. Come back soon, I'll tell you what else I need. There will be something special for you. In the meantime, go on and try on the new clothes.}} ====USEC Exclusive==== * Unlocks purchase of [[USEC Commando lower]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL3 {{quote|You got it? Good work. Come back a bit later, I will have another task for you. You can try on the new clothes, by the way.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Aramid Icon .png|frameless|127px|link=Aramid fiber fabric]] |[[Aramid fiber fabric]] |5 |Handover item !Yes |Can be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Lavatory lv. 1). |- ![[File:Ripstop icon.png|frameless|127px|link=Ripstop fabric]] |[[Ripstop fabric]] |10 |Handover item !Yes |Can be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Lavatory lv. 1). |- ![[File:ParacordIcon.png|frameless|127px|link=Paracord]] |[[Paracord]] |3 |Handover item !Yes |Can be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Lavatory lv. 2). |} [[Aramid fiber fabric]] can commonly be found in clothing stores on [[Interchange]]. [[Ripstop fabric]] can be found in the same locations, though more rarely. They can also be found inside of [[Sport bag]]s, [[Buried barrel cache]]s, and [[Ground cache]]s. [[Paracord]] can be found in [[Sport bag]]s. They can also be found spawning on the map [[Reserve]]. For more specific spawn locations visit the [[Paracord]] page.
